intent: An anchored, non-modal font picker: a searchable list where each family previews in its own typeface, with an optional installed-fonts access step.
guidance: Non-modal and hosted on InspectorDialog: it anchors to the inspector surface's left edge, so it clears the panel at any width. Drive it controlled — value is the applied family, onSelect fires the chosen name, and the owner applies it and closes. Each row previews in its own face; Google families lazy-load their stylesheet on view and on pick. Only the first 60 matches render — search filters the full (~2k) roster to reach the rest. The installed-fonts step degrades honestly: an unsupported browser shows a note, a denied permission keeps the bundled list and offers a retry. It reopens clean, dropping any stale query or half-open explainer.

anatomy.description: 40px title bar ("Fonts") with a close X; it is the first child, so it doubles as the drag handle.
Input with a leading magnifier and a clear X; filters the entire merged roster by name.

Scrolling area (max-h 316px). Each row is a button previewing the family in its own stack, with a check + highlight when selected; caps at 60 rows and shows a "Showing X of Y — search to narrow" hint, or a "No fonts found" row when empty.
Bottom row that opens the access step, or reports an honest state: unsupported-browser note, "N installed fonts added", or a retry label after denial.
Alternate surface swapped in for the whole dialog: header, a MonitorSmartphone icon + explanation, and a "Learn more" link plus a "Continue" button that requests local-font permission.

use_when: Choosing a type family in the inspector, where the picker should stay beside the rail and each option must preview in-face.
You need search across a large roster (bundled + Google + installed) with capability-honest local-font access.
dont_use_when: A blocking, centered choice that must be dismissed before continuing — use a modal Dialog/Modal.
A short, fixed set of options at the trigger — use Dropdown.

slots.trigger: The Font control (a ReactElement) that anchors the dialog and re-receives focus on dismissal.

states: access denied ("Couldn't access installed fonts — try again")
overflow ("Showing X of Y — search to narrow")
installed unsupported ("Installed fonts need a supported browser")

tokens.note: All color, border, radius and elevation bind to c-* / --composa / --elevation tokens — no hex color literals. Type is mixed: the header, access body and "Use installed fonts" row use --composa-body-medium tokens, but the search input, the preview row name (13px/20px) and the overflow/empty/unsupported hints (10–11px, font 450/500) use hardcoded px type sizes rather than a type token.

a11y.role: dialog — non-modal (aria-modal=false). The InspectorDialog / AnchoredInspectorOverlay host renders role="dialog" with aria-label="Fonts" on the portalled Popover content. Focus is not trapped; Escape or outside-click closes and returns focus to the trigger.
a11y.search: input carries aria-label "Search fonts"; the clear button aria-label "Clear search".
a11y.rows: each font row is a <button> with aria-pressed reflecting the applied selection.
a11y.close: close button aria-label "Close fonts"; the access screen's is "Dismiss installed fonts".
a11y.installed: the affordance reports state as visible text (unsupported note, "N installed fonts added", or a retry label after denial) rather than failing silently.

code.example: <FontPickerDialog open={open} onClose={close} trigger={<Button label={font} />} value={font} onSelect={setFont} />
